newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil cargoes down, barges up.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil cargoes down, barges up.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil barges were firmer on Monday but cargo prices were notionally weaker, traders said.

High sulphur barges were traded as low as $83 fob ARA in the morning for a very prompt RMH piece, but a rash of deals in the afternoon saw trades at $91. "These are both artificial levels, one barge player said.

Cargoes were weaker. An April high sulphur cargo was heard to have been concluded into an Irish utility at an aggressive number, which some felt was around $86 cif NWE. This number could not be confirmed.
Traders and brokers doubted this kind of number could be repeated, and said offers were now closer to $90/$91.
Low sulphur fuel oil was stable. Physical indications were pegged at $105 or $106 on a cif Med basis, roughly in line with fob swaps talk at around $94 fob NWE.
